response.justification: Bogdan has extensive fullstack experience with TypeScript, React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL-like SQL databases, plus strong architectural and DevOps exposure — but his title history (Staff/Senior) vastly exceeds the junior/mid-level role, and his resume lacks clear evidence of recent REST API or Nest.js work, while his German language skill is only basic despite high on-site requirements.
strengths: Deep TypeScript and fullstack experience across multiple frameworks
Proven DevOps and infrastructure skills (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD)
Strong open-source contributions and architectural thinking
concerns: Overqualified with senior/staff titles mismatched to junior role
No explicit mention of Nest.js or REST API design experience
Basic German proficiency conflicts with high on-site presence requirement
